opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity, then note
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search round-trip flights on Google Flights, search hotels on Booking, search a top tour on Viator, and save a summary trip note.
steps: Open Google Flights, set origin, destination, departure and return dates, search
Note the cheapest flight airline and price
Open Booking, enter destination and dates, search, open top hotel and note name and price
Open Viator, search for the landmark tour in the destination, open the top result and note title and price
Open Notes, create a new note 'Trip <dest> <dates>: flight..., hotel..., tour...' and press Enter

instances.values: Barcelona, Jan 20-24 2027, Sagrada Familia tour Barcelona

opportunities.name: PyPI package comparison note
opportunities.description: Search a package on PyPI, open its repository link to get stars/license, then record a comparison note of two packages.
steps: Search the package name on PyPI and press Enter
Open the package result and note version and date
Click the Repository/Source link and note stars and license
After two packages, open Notes and add a new note comparing them

opportunities.name: Browser feature support reply email
opportunities.description: Look up a web feature on caniuse and MDN, then draft an email to a person with the supporting browser version and MDN docs link.
steps: Search the feature on caniuse and read the browser version support
Search the feature on MDN and open the doc page
Compose email: To recipient, subject 'Re: <feature> in <browser>', body with version and docs URL
